Without those two tables it is not possible to determine objectively which U.S. major airports moved up at least one rank position and had a 2024 on‑time arrival rate between 77 % and 81.5 %.  

If you can provide the two BTS tables (or a publicly‑accessible link where the data are presented in a machine‑readable format), I can compare the 2023 and 2024 rankings and return the list of IATA codes that satisfy the criteria.  Alternatively, you might download the “Annual On‑Time Arrival Rankings for Major Airports” Excel files directly from the BTS Open‑Data Catalog (they are usually named something like `Annual_On-Time_Arrival_Rankings_Major_Airports_2023.xlsx` and `...2024.xlsx`) and supply the relevant subsets for me to analyze.

Data from Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS). They produce On-Time Performance data and probably provide tables by airport. The On-Time Arrival Rankings per year.
